openrouter.provider_statement: The Free Models Router openrouter/free has zero prompt and completion token pricing.

nvidia.provider_statement: NVIDIA states that Developer Program members get free access to NVIDIA-hosted NIM API endpoints for prototyping; the API Catalog quickstart creates a Developer API key through that Developer Program access flow. This provider-global documentation does not by itself prove that a concrete stored credential is covered by the free entitlement.
nvidia.credential_binding_observation: The listed candidate fingerprint was materialized by the sandbox credential inventory and authenticated successfully against integrate.api.nvidia.com hosted NIM routes. Authentication success and key presence are provenance signals only and do not self-admit the credential under supervisor 8.71.
nvidia.credential_plan_proof: Before autonomous FREE_ONLY model network execution, credential_entitlements must contain the exact fingerprint with provider_side_zero_cost_confirmed=true, provider-side Developer Program/free hosted-NIM entitlement evidence, an observation timestamp, a SHA-256 digest of that evidence object, and an explicit allowed_models list containing the requested model.
nvidia.scope: NVIDIA-hosted API Catalog/NIM prototyping endpoint only; no dedicated enterprise endpoint

groq.credential_plan_proof: A historical or live response for the same credential fingerprint and exact model must expose x-ratelimit-limit-requests and x-ratelimit-limit-tokens matching the documented Free Plan limits.

mistral.provider_statement: Mistral Free mode includes API usage; API keys themselves are not plan-scoped and can also use pay-as-you-go settings.
mistral.credential_plan_proof: Require provider-side Free-mode/pay-as-you-go-disabled evidence bound to the organization/workspace before autonomous calls. Ordinary key presence or HTTP 402 is insufficient.
